observationFindings.title: VISIBLE_CONTEXT_RACE
observationFindings.detail: recordShadow is a fire-and-forget void IIFE launched after visible send; buildQuickShadowSummary runs getUser + domain fetch serially; immediate natural-language follow-up can arrive before context_ready. Route returns before shadow finishes.

observationFindings.title: shadow refetch can observe newer data than panel
observationFindings.detail: panel rendered at T0 from bot data; shadow refetch at T1>T0 may return a newer play/BP, so conversation context can describe data the user never saw.

observationFindings.title: help/ping/dice/bind replies invisible to context
observationFindings.detail: handlers send reply and return handled without recordQuickContext; quick path runs before bot.ts history recording, so neither user message nor reply enters db.messages.

observationFindings.title: failure replies recorded as successful context
observationFindings.detail: catch path sends error text and records "【快捷查询】... 查询失败：<error>" into db.messages as assistant context.

observationFindings.title: bridge pm/etx/rating/update image-only context is generic
observationFindings.detail: no capability/shadow user -> record("快捷指令查询完成（source 面板，结果见图片）", images); source kept but no domain facts.

observationFindings.title: command ownership partially lost in bridge text record
observationFindings.detail: record prefix is [source] text; alias/command id not stored, so ownership=bot family only.

resourceFindings.title: bridge base64 image files never cleaned
resourceFindings.detail: imageSourceToCq saves base64 replies to data/bot-bridge with flag wx and no retention. Measured 2026-08-16: 279 files, 112,318,262 bytes in G:/QQ-AI-ChatBot/data/bot-bridge.

resourceFindings.title: Wuxin bridge timers/sockets clean across 24 offline fixtures
resourceFindings.detail: tools/quick-bridge-reliability-verify.mjs: Timeout handle deltas all 0; single settlement on all paths; server observed socket close on resolve/reject; no unhandled rejections.

resourceFindings.title: Kanon target-side unbounded ACK wait + callback leak
resourceFindings.detail: kanon API.Send waits AsyncManualResetEvent with no timeout; if Wuxin never ACKs (or malformed ACK deserializes to null), command task and CallbackList entry stay forever. Unsolicited ACK echo throws and disconnects client.

resourceFindings.title: Kanon target-side lock-free client registry race
resourceFindings.detail: Clients.Get/Iter are unlocked over mutating Dictionary; message during connect/disconnect can NRE -> spurious disconnect.

resourceFindings.title: Yumu target-side unbounded Bot registry
resourceFindings.detail: each unique x-self-id creates a Bot that stays until socket disconnect; no cap. Bridge bug could open unbounded sessions.

resourceFindings.title: LazyBot upstream HTTP has no timeout
resourceFindings.detail: ApiRequestExecutor/TemplateRenderer use Hutool with no explicit timeout -> stalled upstream can occupy command virtual thread indefinitely while WS stays open. Bot currently paused.

resourceFindings.title: Hydrant per-connection instance disposed on disconnect
resourceFindings.detail: SocketDisconnected disposes Hydrant instance; no cross-call leak found.

resourceFindings.title: recordShadow fire-and-forget tasks can outlive route
resourceFindings.detail: shadow IIFE not awaited; in shutdown/stress these tasks may still run. V01 documented instrumentation visibility only; behavior unchanged.
